title: The $6,000 Minimum Payment Trap

beats.say: A $6,000 credit card balance at 24% APR destroys your finances slowly.
beats.visual: A dark wooden desk with a black credit card resting flat under harsh single-source spotlight, close-up shot.

beats.say: If you only pay the minimum each month, here's what happens.
beats.visual: A stack of unopened paper bills sitting beside a ceramic coffee cup on a grey kitchen counter, moody morning light.

beats.say: You think you're handling it because the monthly bill looks small.
beats.visual: A person's hand pressing buttons on a dark calculator, side angle, no visible numbers on screen.

beats.say: At 24% interest, debt doubles every three years according to the rule of 72.
beats.visual: A heavy iron key sitting on a blank dark leather notebook, dramatic side shadows, macro shot.

beats.say: Paying only the 1% minimum plus interest keeps you locked in for 252 months.
beats.visual: A wall calendar with pages fluttering in slow motion, out of focus background, moody cinematic lighting.

beats.say: That's roughly 21 years of payments on a single balance.
beats.visual: A vintage hourglass resting on a dark slate surface, sand grains falling slowly, close-up.

beats.say: But here's the part credit card companies never highlight.
beats.visual: A closed laptop lid on a dark desk with a single pen beside it, top-down view.

beats.say: By the time it's zero, you've paid $10,887 in interest alone.
beats.visual: A spilled cup of dark coffee spreading across a wooden tabletop, moody high-contrast lighting.

beats.say: That's nearly double the original item you bought.
beats.visual: Two empty metal scales hanging on a dark minimalist balance beam, studio lighting.

beats.say: Switching to a $300 fixed payment clears that exact balance in just 26 months.
beats.visual: A hand sliding a sleek metal pen across a blank dark paper journal, close-up macro.

beats.say: Stop feeding the trap and pay more than the minimum.
beats.visual: A hand turning off a brass desk lamp in a dim room, deep shadows, cinematic atmosphere.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A dark hallway with a single warm light at the far end, symmetrical framing, cinematic depth.

caption: The math behind credit card minimum payments is brutal. Here's why paying just the minimum costs you thousands. #personalfinance #debtfree #moneytips #financialfreedom
description: Breaking down how a $6,000 credit card balance at 24% APR takes 21 years and over $10,000 in interest when paying only the minimum.
